name: Spatial Hashing for Voxel Storage
definition: Replaces RLE encoding to enable O(1) voxel lookup and support dynamic scenes and streaming by storing voxels as bitmasks and a hash table for attributes.
summary: Spatial Hashing for Voxel Storage enables O(1) voxel lookup by mapping positions to a hash table, trading higher memory overhead for constant-time access unlike linear scan methods.
